You reach toward your injured companion and send a surge of warmth into their body. Their breathing strengthens as your own knees briefly weaken.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Reason
Target / range / shape
One willing creature within 3 squares, including self
Duration
Instant
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Magic / Recovery

Moser’s law of conservation of Life energy: pay 7 HP before rolling; bypass resistance and remain above 0 HP. Requires a free hand. Life resistance reduces restoration, minimum 1 where HP is missing. Healing-harmed creatures take the rolled result as Life damage. No resurrection or removal of wounds/Grit loss.

Weak
Restore 8 HP.
Standard
Restore 16 HP.
Strong
Restore 24 HP; the recipient may stand without spending movement and move 1 square without provoking.

Additional rulings

Offensive healing — latest agreement: this spell may target an unwilling creature harmed by healing. Resolve it as an attack using its printed attribute, range, action and HP cost; the HP result becomes Life damage, without beneficial recovery riders. This is the explicit exception to willing-only targeting above. Use the creature’s printed defense when a player defends; no opposed second roll.
